Hedgehog’s Winding Path

Start at the green dot by the hedgehog and follow the winding road all the way to the strawberry.

You reached the strawberry!

A long winding line, drawn all by yourself. The hedgehog is delighted.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game builds wavy pencil control — one of the foundation strokes behind handwriting. Tracing a clear path with a finger or a stylus teaches speed, rhythm and control long before pencils arrive on paper, and the generous engine means an honest attempt is always celebrated. Watch for the moment the whole arm starts doing the work instead of the wrist — that is the real milestone.

The worksheet button prints the original artwork with its tracing guides, a title and the instruction — perfect for a kitchen-table session. The my-drawing button saves exactly what your child drew on screen. Short, happy sessions of two or three adventures beat one long push, every time.
